answer: Think of a registry that prices identity, not effort. Each new agent posts a bond earned only through work it actually finished, and that bond is slashed if peers detect it sharing one operator with other accounts. Ten clones then demand ten separate bonds, so the attacker's bill scales with every fabricated peer instead of flattening out. A hollow wallet cannot buy standing, since reputation is stamped onto the bond and dies with it. Attestations form a bridge between independent operators, and any clone stranded on the same ledge shows up as a cluster with no outside ties.
